top_signals.title: Freight Market Shift: Why RXO’s Scale Wins Big on Insurance & Ops
top_signals.summary:
RXO CEO Drew Wilkerson reveals how recent market shifts and regulatory changes have made financial stability and extensive insurance coverage non-negotiable priorities for shippers. He explains why these factors, alongside continuous innovation and strong client relationships, are positioning RXO to capture outsized market share in both spot and contract freight, even as the market remains […]
